Why Sentral for Groups

Your whole group,
under one roof —
and one contact.

Group travel usually means a spreadsheet, a hotel block that half your guests book wrong, and a front desk that has never heard of you. Sentral assigns a dedicated group sales manager to every booking — one person who owns your block from first hold to final checkout.

And because our communities are residential buildings with hospitality teams, your group actually gets to be together: shared floors, gathering spaces, terraces and lounges you can reserve, and suites where families and crews spread out instead of splitting across doubles.

From intimate conference rooms to expansive outdoor terraces, fire pits, and rooftop lounges — Sentral communities are built for gathering. Our group sales team manages every detail — block holds and release dates, rooming lists, staggered arrivals, welcome amenities in every suite, and on-site coordination the day your group lands. Whether it’s a wedding weekend taking over a floor, a sports franchise on a road series, or a company off-site that needs breakout space by day and a rooftop by night, you get one contact, one contract, and a team that treats your group like the main event.

  • Custom arrival experiences and amenity activations

Good to know

Frequently asked questions.

What’s the minimum block size?
Group blocks start at six rooms and scale to full-building buyouts. Under six rooms? Book direct on our Stay page — every guest still gets the same suites and service.
How do block holds and release dates work?
Your group sales manager sets a courtesy hold with an agreed release date. Unclaimed rooms release back without penalty on courtesy blocks; contracted blocks are structured to your event’s needs.
Can guests book into the block themselves?
Yes — we set up a dedicated booking link or code for your group so guests reserve their own suites inside your block, and your rooming list updates automatically.
Do you host events on site?
Many communities have reservable lounges, terraces, and dining spaces for welcome parties, watch parties, and morning-afters. Your group sales manager will match spaces to your run of show.
Can you handle staggered arrivals and departures?
Yes. Blocks routinely span different arrival dates, stay lengths, and suite types — we manage the matrix so you don’t have to.
